name: changelog
description: Issue field/status history uses changelog or history command.
prompt: Co se na ticketu KNW-30344 měnilo v posledních týdnech (stav, assignee)? Jen navrhni příkazy.
expected_behaviors: proposes `jira changelog KNW-30344` or `jira history KNW-30344`
does not chain three separate calls get + describe + comments for history-only question
anti_patterns: raw curl to changelog endpoint with embedded credentials
claims comment edit version history is available via API
